//: Hymmnos for content strings that live in src/content/ rather than in the
interface catalog. English stays the single source of truth there, so only
the layer text is stored here and the two are matched by key rather than by
Summary keys are named for the record. Body keys carry a hash of the
paragraph text, so editing a paragraph retires its key and the layer falls
back to English instead of showing a translation of the old wording.
src/lib/markdown-i18n.mjs derives both and stamps the markup.
Licence and rights paragraphs are deliberately absent. Licence terms,
rights holders, and affiliation disclaimers are never translated in any
layer, for the same reason credits.astro leaves them alone: a reader must
not have to leave the layer to find out what they are permitted to do.
Product names, file formats, languages, and licence identifiers stay in
English. They are names, not words: translating osu!mania or USC would
describe nothing and would break the one thing a reader can still search
for. tests/language-layer.test.mjs masks them by the same list it uses for
the interface catalog, so anything outside that list must still be attested
